title: Jungle Scene 8 — Find the Animal From Clues
purpose: Finding the right rainforest animal from multiple location and feature clues.

sentenceModels: Find the frog under the leaf.
Point to the sloth on the vine.
Show me the striped animal behind the leaves.
Which bird is on the right?
First point to the monkey, then point to the toucan.

adultSupport.focus: Use multi-part clue sentences to identify the correct animal.
starterPrompts: Can you find the frog under the leaf?
Which animal is hanging from the vine?
Which bird is on the right?
Who is on the branch on the left?
expansionPrompts: First point to the parrot, then point to the sloth.
Find the striped animal behind the leaves and then the green animal under the leaf.

visualAudit: One monkey sitting on a branch on the left.
One parrot flying near the top centre-left.
One sloth hanging from a vine on the right of centre.
One frog under a leaf on the lower-left and one tiger partly behind leaves on the lower-right.
